issues.on_page: Governmental Transfers Out (30,000) p5/p6; General Fund schedule 8000 Transfers 33,419 and 3990 Other State Receipts 3,419 (pp10-11); School Nutrition Transfers from General Fund 33,419 (p8)
issues.issue: The statement nets the 3,419 receipt against the 33,419 transfer, so governmental transfers out (30,000) and business-type transfers in (33,419) disagree by 3,419. Detail records the 3,419 as revenue and -33,419 as transfer, so General Fund detail revenue is 3,419 above the statement's General Fund receipts. The figures are recorded as printed. No report_discrepancies entry was made; the user should know about it.
